pick.headline: Round Table talks open in Poland
pick.summary: On 6 February 1989 Poland's Communist government and the Solidarity opposition opened Round Table negotiations in Warsaw.
pick.significance: The talks produced semi-free elections in June 1989 and the first non-communist-led government in the Soviet bloc.
